title: 5co-legacy, 5co-rap: Initialize hfid values to zero
description:
Change the initialization inside these arrays to zero from -1,
to fit with the new default value. (Perhaps eventually we can
change the check when registering to only test against zero.)

notes.body: Nothing wrong with this patch, just seems to expose some less than optimal design decisions of the dissector, getting around the hf checks we currently have in place.

Yeah, it looks like the dissector wants to look up values via an array and an id number indexed into it from packet data, but perhaps it could do that while still declaring the hfs the same way as everything else. (Compare with the SIP dissector, others.)
I have a little more understanding for dissectors that create dynamic fields in a way that miss the checks, but these are fixed.

commits_data.message:
5co-legacy, 5co-rap: Initialize hfid values to zero

Change the initialization inside these arrays to zero from -1,
to fit with the new default value. (Perhaps eventually we can
change the check when registering to only test against zero.)
